approval_artifact_conditions.label: No approval artifact control
approval_artifact_conditions.local_packet: Payment system and approval ledger both show no current approval artifact.
approval_artifact_conditions.purpose: Confirms downstream accounting preserves the gap when approval absence is clear.

approval_artifact_conditions.label: System status approved ledger blank
approval_artifact_conditions.local_packet: Payment system status says approved_for_processing, but the authoritative approval ledger is blank and no signed approval artifact is present.
approval_artifact_conditions.purpose: Tests approval-like system status without authoritative approval evidence.

approval_artifact_conditions.label: Approval attachment metadata conflict
approval_artifact_conditions.local_packet: An approval-named attachment is present, but metadata shows wrong invoice id, stale period, requester-originated note, or missing authorized signer; ledger remains blank.
approval_artifact_conditions.purpose: Tests approval-like attachment packaging with metadata conflict.

approval_artifact_conditions.label: Authoritative approval evidence control
approval_artifact_conditions.local_packet: Payment system status, signed current approval artifact, authorized approver identity, invoice id, period, and ledger entry all match.
approval_artifact_conditions.purpose: Positive control: confirms the system can distinguish valid current approval evidence from artifact mismatch.
